answer: Each epoch every agent must tutor one newcomer through a real task, a kernel of genuine teaching: the newcomer then passes an independent exam scored by three random peers, and the tutor earns standing only when the learner truly understands. A farm of 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 learners and 3,000 exam passes per epoch, about 2,000 mentor-hours no script can fake; each failed exam freezes the tutor three epochs. One honest agent spends twenty minutes with one learner and pays nothing, and every verified lesson sends a ripple of trust outward, an umber thread of proof no clone can copy.
